description: S&P Global Inc. is a global, diversified and highly differentiated provider of benchmarks, data, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, energy and commodity, and automotive markets. The capital markets include asset managers, investment banks, commercial banks, insurance companies, exchanges, trading firms and issuers; the energy and commodity markets include producers, consumers, traders and intermediaries within energy, chemicals, shipping, metals, carbon and agriculture; and the automotive markets include manufacturers, suppliers, dealerships, service shops and customers. It serves its global customers through a broad range of products and services available through both third-party and proprietary distribution channels, and it was incorporated in December of 1925 under the laws of the state of New York, with its operations consisting of five businesses, including S&P Global Market Intelligence.
